en_title: Hunger Games Director Hopes You Aren't Too Distracted With GTA 6 to See Sunrise on the Reaping
cn_title: 导演盼玩家兼顾《GTA6》与新片
subtitle: 玩游戏，也别忘了看电影
opus_summary: 《饥饿游戏》导演表示，《GTA6》与前传《饥饿游戏：收获日出》档期相近，希望观众能兼顾两者。他打趣说，可以先玩游戏，再去看电影，之后继续玩，也分享了自己最爱的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Francis Lawrence, director of Netflix’s BioShock movie, opened up to IGN about his favorite video games of all time, and we have to admit that he knows ball.
paragraphs.cn: Netflix《生化奇兵》电影导演Francis Lawrence向IGN分享了自己有史以来最喜欢的电子游戏。不得不承认，他确实懂行。

paragraphs.en: You might know Lawrence from his work on the Hunger Games films. He's directed almost every single one of them, after all, most recently lending his talents to the upcoming prequel film Sunrise on the Reaping , which hits theaters this November.
paragraphs.cn: 你或许是通过《饥饿游戏》系列电影认识Lawrence的，毕竟这个系列几乎每一部都由他执导。他最近执导的前传电影《饥饿游戏：收获日出》将于今年11月上映。

paragraphs.en: With a slew of blockbuster adaptations under his belt, Lawrence is now helming the live-action BioShock movie at Netflix — a project that's nearly 20 years in the making. Given he’s a self-professed fan of the series, we had to ask about his favorite games of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 执导过多部改编大片的Lawrence，如今正在为Netflix执导真人版《生化奇兵》电影，这个项目已筹备了近20年。既然他自称是该系列的粉丝，我们自然要问问他有史以来最喜欢哪些游戏。

paragraphs.en: "Well, the big ones for me were Metal Gear Solid , BioShock, and Call of Duty, " he answered. "I'd say the original GTA . I don't think I played beyond the original GTA, but the original one was pretty wild when that came out, the sort of technology of it. But I think those were all kind of my favorites."
paragraphs.cn: 他回答说：「对我来说，最重要的几款是《潜龙谍影》《生化奇兵》和《使命召唤》。我还要说初代《GTA》。我记得自己应该没玩过初代之后的《GTA》，不过初代刚推出时，技术方面确实相当惊人。我想这些大概就是我最喜欢的游戏了。」

paragraphs.en: When we brought up the imminent release of GTA 6 — arguably the most technologically advanced game in the franchise and one of the most highly anticipated pop culture launches of all time — Lawrence bemoaned how close the game's release is to Sunrise on the Reaping.
paragraphs.cn: 我们提到《GTA6》即将发售时，Lawrence感叹，这款游戏的发售日与《饥饿游戏：收获日出》的上映日期实在太近了。《GTA6》可以说是该系列技术最先进的一作，也是流行文化史上最受期待的新作之一。

paragraphs.en: "Unfortunately, I think it comes out right around the same time our movie does. Hopefully, people find time for both. Play GTA, go see our movie, play more GTA," he joked.
paragraphs.cn: 他开玩笑说：「不巧的是，我记得它的发售时间和我们电影上映差不多。希望大家能抽出时间兼顾两者。先玩《GTA》，去看我们的电影，然后继续玩《GTA》。」

paragraphs.en: We got the chance to chat with Lawrence about his BioShock movie , which he said was initially brought to him by Gore Verbinski back in 2009. However, due to scheduling conflicts, he wasn’t able to take the project. Guillermo del Toro was later in talks to direct the film, but "didn’t see eye-to-eye" with the game’s creator, as Lawrence put it.
paragraphs.cn: 我们有机会与Lawrence聊了聊他的《生化奇兵》电影。他说，早在2009年，戈尔·维宾斯基就曾找他接手这个项目，但由于档期冲突，他没能接下。此后，吉尔莫·德尔·托罗也曾洽谈执导该片，不过用Lawrence的话说，他与游戏创作者「意见不合」。

paragraphs.en: The version of events that Guillermo del Toro gave to us, however, was far less mild. "We had a very contentious call about a couple of games," he told us as part of our IGN30 Icons interview series. "...So adapting it, BioShock, we had a couple of calls. They are probably one of the most disastrous calls I've ever had. So no, f**k no."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，吉尔莫·德尔·托罗向我们讲述这段经历时，措辞远没有这么温和。他在IGN30 Icons系列采访中告诉我们：「我们曾围绕几款游戏打过一通电话，争执非常激烈。……所以，关于改编《生化奇兵》，我们通过几次电话。那几通可能是我经历过的最糟糕的通话。所以，不，妈的，绝不。」

paragraphs.en: Lawrence is also gearing up to direct a film adaptation of Red Rising , a young adult book series written by author Peirce Brown. That project, too, has been in development hell, but finally found a home at Paramount and a writer to pen the script.
paragraphs.cn: Lawrence还在筹备执导《Red Rising》的电影改编版，原作为作家Peirce Brown创作的青少年小说系列。这个项目同样经历了漫长的开发困境，但最终落户派拉蒙，也找到了执笔剧本的编剧。
